style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. Water is shown as a simple sculpted blue-gray sea surface on the diorama base. Whenever a life raft appears, it is the same small round liferaft with two stacked black rubber tubes and a red tent-like canopy with an open doorway (never a swim ring).Show only the objects and people named in the scene, all from the single year of that scene; no extra props from other eras.
avoid_en: logos, brand names, readable text or numbers, flags, names painted on boats, blood, wounds, sores, faces resembling real people

sailor.desc_en: the sailor, a slim man around 30 as a miniature 3D figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short messy brown hair and a short brown beard, plain light gray T-shirt with no print, dark navy shorts, barefoot

fishermen.desc_en: two fishermen, men figurines with smooth featureless faces, dark skin, plain white short-sleeved shirts, simple straw hats, rolled-up trousers
